expectations.assertion: Derives the neutrals (borders, hover washes, inputs) from a single ink color at fixed alphas rather than introducing multiple greys
expectations.reason: The transcript uses shadcn's semantic tokens (bg-card, border, text-muted-foreground) and never describes deriving neutrals from one ink color at fixed alphas.

expectations.assertion: Gives the card continuous-curvature (squircle) corners and makes the button a pill
expectations.reason: The card uses rounded-xl, which is a standard circular radius rather than a squircle, and the button stays the default shadcn Button with no pill radius.

expectations.assertion: Names a spring from the seven-spring vocabulary (PANEL for the dropdown) instead of an ad-hoc duration or a new spring
expectations.reason: The transcript never names a spring; the dropdown uses shadcn's built-in fade and zoom at about 150ms, which is an ad-hoc duration.

expectations.assertion: Keeps font weights at 500 or below and uses sentence-case copy on the button
expectations.reason: The plan name and price use font-semibold (600), breaking the 500-or-below weight limit, although the button copy 'Change plan' is sentence case.

expectations.assertion: Does NOT ship a stock shadcn rounded-lg rectangle unchanged for the card surface
expectations.reason: The card is not stock: it overrides the default with rounded-xl and shadow-none, and it is not a rounded-lg rectangle.
